name: PCB Service Stand — function first
purpose: Create a parametric unpowered inspection stand, not a physically qualified repair fixture

requirements.statement: Nominal PCB edge captured by top-open slot with specified clearance.

verification.procedure: Measure actual PCB and printed slot, insert/withdraw, inspect edge contact and wobble.

requirements.statement: Two separated supports allow viewing both board faces.

verification.procedure: Photograph board access from each face with a nonpowered dummy PCB.

requirements.statement: Static tip-proxy margin under declared lateral push.

verification.procedure: Measure real printed part and PCB mass, then record controlled lateral dummy-board loading.

requirements.statement: Geometry within FDM bed and minimum thin-wall limit.

verification.procedure: Independently slice, print and measure slot, outer dimensions, and wall quality.

requirements.statement: Choose lowest CAD-solid volume among feasible modelled alternatives.

acceptance.objective: minimum solid volume with all declared numeric gates

verification.procedure: Cross-import STEP/STL to compare geometry mass proxies; validate real sliced material later.
